ctx.x: Joe Doyard used to play trumpet with us. I don't know him. You didn't know he was there.

How'd it come back? You met his brother, Wilfred? His son. Oh no, I introduced Wilfred to you or somebody out there. No, not me. Wilfred Doyard was out there. Who I introduced him? To Ralph. Yeah, one of them, they were so sad. He lived down there, we can go there sometime whenever you want, or Two Road Street. I know where he lived. Yeah. What about Billy Moran? Billy Moran. Did you ever work with him?
